question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

The speaker's __monotonous__ voice lulled the audience to sleep.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dull**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"monotonous"** means something that is dull, repetitive, and lacking in variety or interest. (नीरस)

 
 
• **Example:** The monotonous routine of his daily life made him feel uninspired.
 
 
 
• **"Dull"** refers to something that is boring, uninteresting, or lacking brightness and liveliness. (सुस्त, उबाऊ)
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that half the audience fell asleep.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'monotonous'** is **'dull'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dull**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Varied** (विविध): Incorporating a number of different types or elements; showing variety.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher used varied teaching methods to keep the students engaged.
 
 
 
• **Interesting** (रोचक): Something that holds or grabs attention and arouses curiosity.
 
 
• **Example:** The book was so interesting that I couldn’t put it down.
 
 
 
• **Exciting** (रोमांचक): Causing great enthusiasm and eagerness.
 
 
• **Example:** The roller-coaster ride was an exciting experience for the kids.
